name: pi-mcp-extension-types
description: Type-only dependencies for typechecking this extension. The extension is loaded by pi from source and is not published as a package; these exist so `tsc -p mcp/tsconfig.json` resolves the host API's types identically on a developer machine and on a clean CI runner. mcp/tsconfig.json previously hardcoded absolute /opt/homebrew/... paths to a globally-installed pi, so its typecheck could only pass on that one machine and failed on any clean checkout.
